story: Brandywine Creek State Park is a public recreation area located in Delaware, USA, along the Brandywine Creek. Established in 1965, it contains nature preserves like Tulip Tree Woods, Freshwater Marsh, and Flint Woods.
matters: The park's forests are part of the Northeastern coastal forests ecoregion. Flint Woods is home to species of rare song birds and an old-growth forest.
name: Brandywine Creek State Park
